part: BP-3 (phone, fresh profile): join W1 — shared by origin/main code, so its history has no `pack` — and see what the land says

actions.eval: (async () => { const b = await window.seed.world.badges(); const id = b.value[0].worldId; const r = await window.seed.world.read(id); const now = r.value.snapshot.now; return JSON.stringify({ world: id, head: now.head.n, pack: now.pack, link: r.value.status.link, role: r.value.status.role }); })()
